_comment: RaylibGame native Linux dedicated server (#792, #326). NOT deployed: importing it on deweyserver's panel needs the user's OK. GPU: the container sees the NVIDIA GPU only when Docker runs it with the nvidia runtime (see tools/pterodactyl/README.md); without one the server runs on its null GL and CPU paths.
name: RaylibGame (Linux)
author: noreply@anthropic.com
description: RaylibGame dedicated server, native Linux build: ./game --server server.cfg (port, max players, password, MOTD, autosave, seed). No display server needed: OpenGL 4.3 from the NVIDIA GPU through EGL when the container has it, else CPU only. Console: help, status, list, save, say, kick, op, ban, stop.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# RaylibGame Linux server install (#792). Either fetches a prebuilt runtime (DOWNLOAD_URL: the .tar.gz that
# tools/build_linux.sh makes) or builds it here from GIT_REPO at GIT_REF (about 10 minutes: GameNetworkingSockets
# and the game). Then writes server.cfg with the panel's values (kept on reinstall: the panel rewrites its lines at
# every start anyway). The save (server/) is never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# (#1830) Wings mounts the install container's /tmp as a small tmpfs: download, clone and build in the server volume.
W=/mnt/server/.install
rm -rf "${W}" && mkdir -p "${W}"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
  apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates tar gzip > /dev/null
  echo "install: downloading ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
  curl -fsSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o ${W}/server.tar.gz
  rm -rf ${W}/unpack && mkdir -p ${W}/unpack && tar -xzf ${W}/server.tar.gz -C ${W}/unpack
  SRC_DIR=${W}/unpack/raylibgame-server
else
  apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends build-essential cmake git curl ca-certificates pkg-config libssl-dev libegl1 binutils > /dev/null
  echo "install: building ${GIT_REPO} at ${GIT_REF} (about 10 minutes)"
  rm -rf ${W}/src && git clone -q --depth 1 --branch "${GIT_REF}" "${GIT_REPO}" ${W}/src
  RAYLIBGAME_VERSION="${GIT_REF} $(git -C ${W}/src rev-parse --short HEAD)" bash ${W}/src/tools/build_linux.sh --inside --out ${W}/linux --jobs "$(nproc)"
  SRC_DIR=${W}/linux/stage/raylibgame-server
fi
[ -x "${SRC_DIR}/game" ] || { echo "install: no game binary in the build"; exit 1; }
rm -rf resources assets lib
cp -a "${SRC_DIR}/." /mnt/server/
chmod +x game
mkdir -p server
if [ ! -f server.cfg ]; then
cat > server.cfg <<EOF
# RaylibGame dedicated server (#326). key = value; '#' starts a comment. Restart the server to apply changes.
save = server/world.sav
port = ${SERVER_PORT}
max_players = ${MAX_PLAYERS}
password = ${SERVER_PASSWORD}
autosave_minutes = ${AUTOSAVE_MINUTES}
motd = ${MOTD}
seed = ${WORLD_SEED}
log = server/server.log
EOF
fi
rm -rf "${W}"
echo "install: done ($(cat VERSION 2>/dev/null || echo unknown version))"

variables.name: Message of the day
variables.description: Shown to players when they join.

variables.name: Autosave minutes
variables.description: Minutes between autosaves (0 = only on stop).

variables.name: World seed
variables.description: Seed for a new world (0 = random). An existing save keeps its own.

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description: Optional: a prebuilt raylibgame-server-linux-x86_64.tar.gz (tools/build_linux.sh). Empty: build from the Git repository below at install.

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: Built at install when no Download URL is set.

variables.name: Git branch or tag
variables.description: What to build at install (reinstall the server to update).

variables.name: NVIDIA GPUs
variables.description: GPUs the NVIDIA container runtime gives the server ('all', a GPU index, or 'void' for none). Only works when Docker runs the container with the nvidia runtime.

variables.name: NVIDIA driver capabilities
variables.description: graphics = the EGL/OpenGL libraries; compute, utility for nvidia-smi.
